name: Nemetra
tagline: Pig-pen and pottery village on the Luric Road, complacent while something gathers to the north.

population.mix: Swineherds and potters, with a large fringe.

ruler: No lord. Militia captain Durvin holds court on the village green.
faiths: Isarna (cracked waystone at the northern trailhead)
strangers: Busy and practical; nobody has time for them unless they bring coin.

near: pig pens sprawling to the west
leaving: clay dust on everything you own

dusk: four kilns glowing on the south edge

day: children chasing piglets through the lanes
dusk: militia laughter from the Royal Welcome

winter: the kilns the only warm place
spring: mud and manure to the ankle

situations.name: Ambarra
descriptors: new households blessed under the oak

itself.title: Pigs and pots
itself.text: Pork and pottery from Nemetra supply the Marches: salted pork, storage jars, roof tiles, decorated ware. The village is more prosperous than it looks, and smells worse.

itself.title: By lizard-man sufferance
itself.text: Nemetra exists because the lizard-men to the south allow it. There is no compact, tribute, or acknowledgement. A few elders sense it, and none say it aloud.

itself.title: Something in the north
itself.text: Goblin refugees have started appearing in the pig pens, gaunt and silent. The militia laughs at them. The herb-wives are studying them, and are afraid.

day: **Captain Durvin** drills the militia on the green and boasts of the goblins he has tamed.
A **goblin refugee** bolts from the pig pens when approached.
**Master Potter Halbet** inspects a kiln load and smashes the flawed pieces.
**Torvek** the smith complains to anyone near the forge about the iron shortage.
**Mother Yaleth** sends a herb-wife to fetch the party.
A potter's cart of storage jars sets out for the road.
night: Militia singing at the Royal Welcome.
A potter sleeps beside a glowing kiln.
A goblin in the pig pens whispers one word in Common, then stops.
**Mother Yaleth** smokes on the compound steps, watching the north.
A fire burns far off in the northern woods.
The pigs panic in their pens at nothing anyone can see.

response.watch: 30 militia under Captain Durvin, 15 of them veterans.
response.reinforcements: None; the veterans are already counted.
response.bribery: A round at the Royal Welcome buys a militiaman's silence about almost anything.
response.strength: Overconfident and under-informed. Patrols stop short of where the trouble is.

locations.name: Village Green
locations.look: The central green under a great Bandua-blessed oak.

labels.custom: Announcements, markets, and militia drills. Captain Durvin holds court here.

labels.services: Pork stew, nut bread, herbed ale; 6 rooms upstairs.

locations.name: Pottery Quarter
locations.look: Four large kilns by the clay pits on the southern edge, always smoking.

labels.wares: Storage jars, roof tiles, decorated pottery.

locations.name: Pig Pens
locations.look: Sprawling, stinking enclosures on the western side.
locations.hidden: Goblin refugees hide among the pigs at night.

locations.name: Herb-Wives' Compound
locations.look: Three connected houses on the eastern edge, in gardens of medicinal and kitchen herbs.

locations.name: Shrine to Bandua
locations.look: A stone hearth-shrine by the oak.

labels.populace: Tended by Elder Corveth, a retired militiaman.

locations.name: Scribe's Shed
locations.look: A cramped lean-to against the Royal Welcome.

labels.off_the_books: Hires anyone literate or strong to dig in the northern ruins.

locations.name: Northern Trailhead
locations.look: Where the road narrows into the forest, marked by a cairn and a cracked Isarna waystone.
locations.hidden: Fresh gnoll and goblin tracks, plain to anyone who looks.

factions.scheme: Drinking, and dismissing the gnoll threat.
Studying the goblin refugees to learn what is coming.

trouble: Militia dismisses gnoll threat; herb-wives know it is real
Goblin refugees in the pig pens — villagers mock them, herb-wives study them
Unspoken lizard-man sufferance — Nemetra exists because they permit it
trade_focus: Pork and pottery supplier for the Luric Marches; key stop on the Lamares-Orziben caravan route

legacy_rumours: The goblins are tame now — Durvin tamed them (militia bravado, false)
Something big is burning in the northern woods at night
A goblin woman spoke coherently to one of the herb-wives before going silent again

current_threat.name: The Gnoll Packs of Tharzuul the Ember-Tongue
current_threat.summary: ~100 gnolls in 3 packs (Ashfang, Marrowgnaw, Nighthowl) 4+ hexes north, controlling ~200 enslaved goblins. Led by Tharzuul the Ember-Tongue, an ogre magi preaching fire-worship. Timeline to assault: 5-10 years. Immediate sign: goblin refugees appearing in Nemetra.

ashfang.magic_item: Kethraz's Brand — iron war-club, once/day ignites target

marrowgnaw.magic_item: Marrow-Render — bone saw, harvests bones in 1 round

nighthowl.magic_item: The Smokeveil Fetish — once/day 20' choking smoke cloud

lairs.corrupted_grove: Ashfang. Once druidic, now blackened. Permanent bonfire that whispers (fire elemental magic). 60 goblins enslaved here.
lairs.the_old_ruin: Marrowgnaw. Pre-Fall watchtower, half-collapsed. Hidden basement Yennoghu shrine. 50 goblins enslaved here.
lairs.the_cave_system: Nighthowl. Limestone caves with underground stream. 90 goblins here, some semi-autonomous. Ancient cave paintings.
lairs.the_bone_hollows: Contested — Ashfang vs. Marrowgnaw. Deep ravine of accumulated bones. Occasional undead rise here.
lairs.carrion_ridge: Contested — Marrowgnaw vs. Nighthowl. High ground with old stone circle.
lairs.the_flooded_dell: Contested — Nighthowl vs. Ashfang. Marshy lowland. ~10 fugitive goblins living here.

goblin_refugees.in_nemetra: 6-8 goblins have appeared over the past week. Traumatized, gaunt, hollow-eyed.
goblin_refugees.tikka: Most coherent refugee. Escaped from Nighthowl. Hiding in the pig pens at night. Knows about Tharzuul and the cave tunnels.
goblin_refugees.skrix: Still enslaved at Corrupted Grove. Secretly carves warnings into trees.
goblin_refugees.tharzuuls_staff: Gnarled staff topped with a perpetually smoldering coal that whispers in Ignan. Destroying it might shatter his hold over the packs.

equipment: Basic. Tools, pottery, and pork plenty; iron goods scarce, +25%.
